_doc: KĀLA-YANTRA fixed-operation table (charter §7). The executor reads THIS FILE FROM origin/main (never from a working tree) and refuses any kind not listed or not enabled. `enabled_by` names the item an entry serves; campaign builders never edit this file; open: enablement path. FORMAT RULE: `enabled` is the FIRST key of every entry — the plan model's detectors read it. `script` is a repository-relative path; a read-only operation's script is extracted from origin/main; a production operation runs in a private worktree at the request's reviewed_commit (which must be merged). `fixed_args` are always passed; `allowed_args` are the request-arg keys that may be appended as --key value; `needs` is the capability; `requesters` are the lanes that may request the kind (default: adhikarin only); optional `cwd` (repository-relative), `python_module` (run as python -m) and `timeout_s`. `required_rows` names the checklist rows the verifier's acceptance receipt must attest true for a mutating run of that kind. Gochara authority operations (verification_job, publish_head, rollback_head) and whole-layer operations (layer_verify, layer_publish, layer_rollback) are different surfaces and never substitute for each other. Wave 4 preparation: also_needs requires every additional capability; prepared_dry_run is disabled review metadata, never an executor kind or a dry_run_passed attestation. New kinds require a real child and phase review before enablement. `cloudrun_job_readback` (J-2a, read-only, production:false) measures the deployed pipeline Cloud Run job's image, digest, commit tag and configuration and, with the optional `execution` argument, that execution's completion and, with `logs` (valid only beside `execution`; value `true`), one fixed `gcloud logging read` of that execution's job log parsed for STRETCH_SINK/1 lines and asset.substep progress (SR-J3-READ-KINDS) and, with `metrics` (valid only beside `execution`; value `true`), two fixed `gcloud monitoring time-series list` reads of that execution's CPU and memory utilisation (SR-BOLD-09); it emits ky.cloudrun_readback/1 (fleet/CLOUDRUN_READBACK_v1_0.md). `read_only: true` (A7 D-44) marks a kind whose COMPLETED exit-0 run the executor itself accepts mechanically (acceptance/<op>.post.json, by executor-mechanical; no reviewer). `quiescence_check` (read-only) reads the live sessions that carry a fenced operation's PGAPPNAME marker; on request the executor then measures that operation's quiescence and, only if every check holds, writes acceptance/<op>.quiescence.json (by executor-mechanical). A mechanical post-acceptance or quiescence record is never a pre-acceptance of a writing operation, and an `acceptance_receipt` still has to be by v1..v4; the only mechanical pre-acceptance is the one described at the end of this note. `scheduler_pause` / `scheduler_resume` (+ `*_dryrun`) and the read-only `scheduler_readback` (SR-J3-REAPER-PAUSE, enabled_by J-3c) act on ONE Cloud Scheduler job, `watchdog-reaper` (fleet/scheduler_reaper.py; any other job is refused); a pause must name `resume-by` (UTC, not after its lease end) and the executor arms a durable resume record the loop honours on every tick, restarts included (executor.py scheduler_backstop_*); each receipt carries the job state read back after the action. `measuring_cancel` (SR-J3-CANCEL-NULL, enabled_by J-3c) cancels ONE running execution of the measuring build (fleet/measuring_cancel.py) and only when admission binds the target to the execution named in the cited measuring_dispatch receipt and an ABORT/stall verdict file is cited by sha256; the receipt carries the execution state read back after the cancel (anything but CANCELLED is FAILED); it is never held by the production fence; `measuring_cancel_dryrun` checks the same admission and makes no cloud call. `verification_job` (J-4b, SR-PREBUILD-ALL; fleet/verification_launch.py, enabled_by J-4b) launches ONE run of the already-defined Gochara verification Cloud Run job under the verifier principal for generation 5.0 only: it first reads the registry digest of the reviewed commit and judges the deployed job by the seal workflow's own contract (refusing anything else), writes a durable no-retry claim, makes ONE asynchronous `gcloud run jobs execute` with arguments that are constants of the script (never `--brief`, which belongs to the human-approved seal workflow), and reads the executed resource back; `verification_job_dryrun` does the same reads and validation, then runs the job ONCE in its own `--report-only` mode (persists nothing, writes no claim), waits for that execution (timeout_s 21600 is the executor's cap; the launcher gives up at 21000 s and names the execution), judges the executed resource and prints the job's single report line after its record: the report the pack's dryrun_gate reads (REPORT_ONLY status, gate, the 26 classes) and the measured execution wall time; a definition-only answer carries no report and the gate refuses it. MECHANICAL ACCEPTANCE OF A PRODUCTION WRITE (OWNER-MINIMAL-PROTECTION-NOW-20261018, SR-MINIMAL-PROTECTION §2; fleet/MECHANICAL_ACCEPTANCE_v1_0.md §4): every production kind EXCEPT deletions (each `*_teardown`) and serving changes (`publish_head`, `layer_publish`, `rollback_head`, `layer_rollback`; `measuring_cancel` is held with them) may be accepted by the executor itself, with no V signer, when the request carries `pack_fill` {pack_manifest_sha256, template, fill_sha256} and no `acceptance_receipt`, and ALL hold: the request bytes equal a verified pack fill (the manifest digest is on run/ops/PACK_ALLOWLIST.json, which the cockpit writes only from an ACCEPTED verify job, and that entry pins the template digest per kind), the kind's `<kind>_dryrun` COMPLETED OK for the same item, chart, reviewed_commit and args (the request cites its receipt as `dryrun_receipt` {name, sha256}; `backup_snapshot` and `backup_restore_verify` have no dry-run kind and need none), and the lease is live. The executor then writes acceptance/<operation_id>.json (by executor-mechanical, phase pre, with the request digest and the evidence digests) and re-measures all of it immediately before execution. A request that carries an `acceptance_receipt` is judged by that signer exactly as before. `century_dispatch` (SR-PREBUILD-ALL, item J-4e, enabled_by J-4d) stages the FINAL ordinary candidate run of ka_gochara_v5 — the measuring launch without the test slice: NO slice marker, trigger gochara-v5-century, no horizon or class choice (the writer decides) — then launches exactly that staged run through the same durable no-retry claim (fleet/century_launch.py; builder + gcloud). `century_dispatch_dryrun` (production:false) runs the same staging and ROLLS BACK, printing the plan and the one Cloud Run launch it would make (ky.century_staging/1); the real kind demands its receipt. `century_teardown_dryrun` / `century_teardown` (SR-TEARDOWN-AUTHORITY-GATE item 3) reuse the scoped teardown with a century_scope run_id scope for century-candidate rows; `century_teardown` stays enabled:false until an owner authority naming century candidate rows (OWNER-AUTH-TEARDOWN-v2) is recorded and teardown_gate reads it. `github_run_readback` (U-M-12, read-only, production:false, shipped enabled:false; fleet/github_run_readback.py) measures ONE GitHub Actions run of a protected-window workflow (deploy.yml or the Gochara role-provisioning one-shot; any other workflow is refused) with two fixed `gh api -X GET` calls and prints one ky.window_run/1 line (run status, capability-step start, latest step progress, per-step times) for the window watch; a value GitHub has not set reads null and an unreadable record REFUSES. `protected_window_dispatch` / `protected_window_dispatch_dryrun` (U-M-01, SR-PREBUILD-ALL, enabled_by J-4b; shipped DISABLED, not used in W2) dispatch ONE protected schema window of deploy.yml (fleet/protected_window_launch.py): args exactly {flag, ref, head, window_lease_id}; the live kind is remote_async, refuses while any lease other than window_lease_id (which must be the request's own lease_id) is ACTIVE, returns once the run is identified and writes one ky.window_run/1 line; the GitHub protected-environment approval stays a person's act; the dry run makes every check and no dispatch. `gochara_role_provisioning_dispatch` / `_dryrun` (U-M-03, enabled_by J-4b, DISABLED) dispatch the one-shot workflow gochara-role-provisioning-oneshot.yml, stage create-roles only (fleet/role_provisioning_dispatch.py): both refuse unless `window_lease_id` is the ONE ACTIVE lease on origin/campaign-coordination, neither reads or prints a credential, and the dry run makes no gh call; the production kind is synchronous (its receipt means the workflow was dispatched, not that it finished; the run is read back by a later pack step, and the window's lease stays ACTIVE meanwhile) and takes no production fence, because the fence is released by a quiescence measurement of PGAPPNAME-tagged sessions that a GitHub workflow's connection does not carry.
